simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בְּלוֹא (H1094) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בְּלוֹא (bᵉlôwʼ) means (only in plural construction) rags First listed occurrence: Jer 38 11.

definitions.full: H1094. belo [ בְּלוֺא ] noun [masculine] worn out things , rags (Syriac id. ) plural construct בְּלֹויֵ Jer 38:11 (twice in verse), בְּלוֺאֵי 38:12 .
